11

19	must not weaken or restate any signature below.
20	
21	By a **smooth curve** we mean a geometrically irreducible, smooth scheme of relative dimension one
22	over a field, proper over that field.
23	
24	## Main definitions
25	
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.genus` — genus of a proper, smooth curve.
27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian` — the Jacobian of a proper, smooth curve.
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.ofCurve` — the Abel–Jacobi map associated to a `k`-rational point.

266	    baseChangeIso k M C

9	/-!
10	# Category-correct ambient contract for the rank-one Picard route
11	
12	The rank-one locus lives in degree `genus C`, not in `pic0`. This module installs the concrete
13	ambient maps that the later open-locus restriction must consume:
14	
15	* `abelDivAffTrans` maps the widened degree-`n` divisor functor to `picDegLayerFunctor C n`;
16	* `abelDivAffSigma` extends a represented slice map to the ambient big-site presheaf;
17	* `abelDivAffGenusSigma` specializes the map using the canonical genus representation.
18	
19	The future public `PicRankOneOpen` must therefore be a subfunctor of
20	`picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C)`, and `DivRankOneOpen` must be an open of
21	`divRepAffGenusScheme C`. Its `rankOneAbel` is the restriction of
22	`abelDivAffGenusSigma`, after applying the corresponding Sigma extension. No placeholder locus,
23	inverse, representability witness, or endgame theorem is postulated here.
24	-/

42	/-- The widened Abel transformation into the intrinsic degree-`n` Picard layer. -/
43	def abelDivAffTrans : divFunctorAff C n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ) where
44	  app T := ↾fun s => ⟨abelDivAff' C n T.unop s, fun K _ _ t => degAt_abelDivAff' s t⟩
45	  naturality T T' g := by
46	    ext s
47	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
48	    exact (picEtMap_abelDivAff' g.unop s).symm
49	
50	@[simp]
51	lemma abelDivAffTrans_app_coe
52	    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (s : divFamZarAff C n T.unop) :
53	    ((abelDivAffTrans C n).app T s).1 = abelDivAff' C n T.unop s :=
54	  rfl

57	/-- Extend a represented widened Abel map from the slice over `Spec k` to the big site. -/
58	def abelDivAffSigma {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
59	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) :
60	    yoneda.obj D.left ⟶
61	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ)) :=
62	  rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (abelDivAffTrans C n)

66	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
67	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
68	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).1 = x ≫ D.hom :=
69	  rfl

73	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
74	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
75	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).2.1 =
76	      abelDivAff' C n (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom)) (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)) :=

10	
11	This file isolates the last presheaf step in the arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre construction.

13	affine pullback, and supplies the canonical evaluation-divisor classifier.  The geometric input

15	The universal property of this stronger square produces, rather than assumes, the factorisation
16	field of `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.
17	
18	The global construction of the canonical classifier and its represented pullbacks remains an
19	upstream obligation.  The endpoint here keeps that obligation in its geometric `IsPullback`
20	form and feeds the resulting arbitrary-scheme fibres immediately to
21	`picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented`.

24	declaration below constructs the evaluator, the open family, or its pullback theorem.
25	-/

47	abbrev rankOneAmbient : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
48	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
49	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))
50	
51	abbrev rankOneLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
52	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
53	
54	/-- The divisor families whose Abel class has a rank-one presentation, extended to the big site. -/
55	abbrev rankOneDivisorLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
56	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
57	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor
58	
59	/-- The restricted represented Abel map on the big site. -/
60	def rankOneAbelSigma :
61	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
62	      rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
63	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (rankOneAbelRepresented pi)
64	
65	/-- The ambient class of a divisor already known to lie in the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
66	def rankOneDivisorToAmbient :
67	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C) :=
68	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi
69	
70	/-! ## The explicit geometric input -/
71	
72	/-- The single canonical evaluation-divisor classifier used by every represented fibre.
73	
74	Keeping this datum outside `PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput` prevents the classifier from
75	varying with the test scheme or displayed family. -/
76	structure PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData where
77	  divisor : rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
78	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)
79	  divisor_abel : divisor ≫ rankOneAbelSigma pi = 𝟙 _
80	
81	namespace PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
82	
83	/-- Applying restricted Abel to the canonical evaluation divisor recovers its rank-one class. -/
84	lemma divisor_abel_app (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
85	    (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) :
86	    (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) = v := by
87	  exact congrArg (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_abel
88	
89	/-- The canonical divisor has the original ambient Picard class. -/
90	lemma divisor_toAmbient (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
91	    E.divisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi = picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi := by
92	  rw [rankOneDivisorToAmbient, ← Category.assoc, E.divisor_abel, Category.id_comp]
93	
94	/-- The separate uniqueness obligation saying every divisor in the rank-one presentation
95	preimage is the canonical evaluation divisor of its Abel class. -/
96	def AbelInverse (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) : Prop :=
97	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ E.divisor = 𝟙 _
98	
99	/-- Once divisor uniqueness is proved, restricted Abel and canonical evaluation form the
100	rank-one family isomorphism. -/
101	def evaluationIso (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) (h : E.AbelInverse) :
102	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ≅ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) where
103	  hom := rankOneAbelSigma pi
104	  inv := E.divisor
105	  hom_inv_id := h
106	  inv_hom_id := E.divisor_abel
107	
108	end PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
109	
110	/--
111	The explicit data needed to assemble one arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre.
112	
113	`restrictedValue` is the restriction of the displayed ambient family to `W`, and
114	`nativePresentation` quantifies over every affine pullback of that value.  The parameter `E` is
115	the common evaluation-divisor classifier on the rank-one locus, with its Abel compatibility
116	kept explicit.  Divisor representability is deliberately not a field of this structure: it is
117	supplied separately as a pullback square to the assembly theorem.
118	
119	In particular, no field-fibre dimension witness, unrelated line bundle, or pre-existing
120	`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` is accepted by this contract.  Conversely, this structure is not
121	itself a producer: an inhabitant must still supply the arbitrary-affine native presentations.
122	-/
123	structure PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
124	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
125	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
126	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)) where
127	  W : X.Opens
128	  restrictedValue : rankOneAmbient (C := C).obj (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
129	  restrictedValue_eq :
130	    restrictedValue =
131	      (yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (W : Scheme.{u}))
132	  /-- The tied native presentation on every affine pullback of the restricted family value. -/
133	  nativePresentation :
134	    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
135	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ Over.mk restrictedValue.1),
136	      Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
137	        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op restrictedValue.2))
138	
139	namespace PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
140	
141	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
142	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)}
143	variable {E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi}
144	
145	/-- The public-locus element carried by the restricted family value over `W`. -/
146	noncomputable def locusValue (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
147	    (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) :=
148	  ⟨F.restrictedValue.1, ⟨F.restrictedValue.2,
149	    mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
150	      (fun A _ _ t => F.nativePresentation A t)⟩⟩
151	
152	/-- The map into the public locus is obtained from its universal element by Yoneda. -/
153	noncomputable def fst (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
154	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
155	  yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue
156	
157	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor of the restricted family value over `W`. -/
158	noncomputable def evaluationDivisor
159	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
160	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
161	  F.fst ≫ E.divisor
162	
163	/-- The factorisation clause required by `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, exposed as the target
164	of the represented evaluation-divisor argument below. -/
165	def FibreFactorizationClause
166	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
167	  ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) (w : S ⟶ X),
168	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v =
169	      g.app (op S) w →
170	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (F.W : Scheme.{u}),
171	      F.fst.app (op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ F.W.ι = w
172	
173	lemma fst_comp_incl (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
174	    F.fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
175	  apply yonedaEquiv.injective
176	  change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) F.locusValue =
177	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (F.W : Scheme.{u}))
178	  dsimp [locusValue, picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
179	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat]
180	  rw [← F.restrictedValue_eq]
181	
182	/-- The family evaluation divisor has the displayed family as its Abel class. -/
183	lemma evaluationDivisor_abel
184	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
185	    F.evaluationDivisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi =
186	      yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
187	  rw [evaluationDivisor, Category.assoc, E.divisor_toAmbient]
188	  exact F.fst_comp_incl
189	
190	/-! ## The represented rank-one-divisor fibre square -/
191	
192	/-- The open `W` represents the pullback of the restricted divisor-class map along the displayed
193	family, with its top map fixed by the canonical evaluation divisor.  This is stronger than the
194	factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a categorical pullback against the
195	entire restricted rank-one divisor presheaf. -/
196	def EvaluationDivisorPullback
197	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
198	  IsPullback
199	    F.evaluationDivisor
200	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
201	    (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi)
202	    g
203	
204	/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
205	test scheme. -/
206	lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
207	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
208	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
209	    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
210	  intro S v w hvw
211	  have hS := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op S)
212	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hS
213	  have hcompat :
214	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
215	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
216	        g.app (op S) w := by
217	    have h := congrArg
218	      (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_toAmbient
219	    change
220	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
221	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
222	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v at h
223	    rw [h]
224	    exact hvw
225	  obtain ⟨u, huDivisor, huW⟩ :=
226	    hS.2.2 (E.divisor.app (op S) v) w hcompat
227	  change E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
228	    E.divisor.app (op S) v at huDivisor
229	  change u ≫ F.W.ι = w at huW
230	  refine ⟨u, ?_, huW⟩
231	  calc
232	    F.fst.app (op S) u =
233	        (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S)
234	          (E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u)) :=
235	      (E.divisor_abel_app pi S (F.fst.app (op S) u)).symm
236	    _ = (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) :=
237	      congrArg _ huDivisor
238	    _ = v := E.divisor_abel_app pi S v
239	
240	/-! ## Assembly of the stronger fibre datum -/
241	
242	/-- Assemble the public fibre presentation from the represented canonical evaluation-divisor
243	square.  Its `exists_factor` field is derived from the pullback universal property. -/
244	noncomputable def toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
245	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
246	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
247	    PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g where
248	  W := F.W
249	  fst := F.fst
250	  sq := F.fst_comp_incl
251	  exists_factor := by
252	    simpa only [FibreFactorizationClause] using
253	      F.fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb
254	
255	@[simp]
256	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_W
257	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
258	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
259	    (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb).W = F.W :=
260	  rfl
261	
262	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_isPullback
263	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
264	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
265	    IsPullback F.fst (yoneda.map F.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g :=
266	  (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb).isPullback
267	
268	/-! ## Immediate openness consumer -/
269	
270	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies
271	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
272	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
273	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
274	      PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
275	    (hpb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
276	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
277	      (D X g).EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
278	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
279	  apply picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented pi
280	  intro X g
281	  exact (D X g).toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi (hpb X g)
282	
283	end PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
284	
285	end
286	end AlgebraicGeometry

8	/-!
9	# The Jacobian representability datum (Wave-4 seam D1, `JacobianData`)
10	
11	The pinned representability datum for the degree-zero étale-sheafified relative Picard
12	functor `pic0Functor C` of the challenge curve: a representing object `J`, an honest
13	`Functor.RepresentableBy` datum (no `Nonempty`, no choice), and the two construction
14	certificates (`LocallyOfFiniteType`, `QuasiCompact`).  This is the frozen Wave-4
15	interface shape (`informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §1.1, verbatim), together with the
16	design-§5 consumers `grpObj` / `homEquiv` / `uniqueUpToIso` — and nothing else.
17	
18	## Ownership split (binding, w5-worksheet D1)
19	
20	* The **producer** `jacobianData C : JacobianData C`, the quasi-compactness certificate,
21	  and the discharge of the frozen `Jacobian`/`instGrpObj` sorries of `Challenge.lean`
22	  are **DAT-J property** (the parallel Wave-4 fleet).  None of them lives here.
23	* This file is the **Wave-5/6/7 consumption interface**: downstream files take
24	  `(d : JacobianData C)` as a section variable, activate the group structure per proof
25	  via `letI := d.grpObj` (or `attribute [local instance] JacobianData.grpObj`), and
26	  phrase every statement about `d.J`.  At DAT-J discharge time the frozen gate
27	  instantiates them by `exact theorem_x … (jacobianData C)` — definitionally, since
28	  `Jacobian C := (jacobianData C).J`.
29	* Extensions to this file are **additive only**; the structure shape never changes.
30	
31	## The `forget₂ ⋙ forget` massage
32	
33	`rep` is typed against `(pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat`
34	so that mathlib's `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` applies **verbatim** with
35	`F := pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat`.  The functor value at a test `T` is
36	*definitionally* the coerced subgroup `↥(pic0Subgroup C T)`; `homEquiv` and
37	`homEquiv_comp` below own this defeq once, exposing the equivalence against
38	`pic0Subgroup C T` and the naturality against `pic0Map` — no consumer ever meets the
39	`forget₂ ⋙ forget` spelling again.
40	
41	## η-defeq verdict (recon §5 "lower-order unknown", RECORDED)
42	
43	**POSITIVE, with one keying caveat.**  `Over.mk d.J.hom` is definitionally equal to
44	`d.J` (structure-eta for `Comma`/`CostructuredArrow` plus unit-like eta for the
45	`Discrete PUnit` right leg): the ascription
46	`(d.grpObj : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom))` elaborates as-is, so **no transport lemma is
47	ever needed**.  Caveat: bare instance *search* does not unfold `Over.mk` on its own,
48	so a consumer of `smooth_of_grpObj` — whose group hypothesis is `[GrpObj (Over.mk f)]`
49	at `f := d.J.hom` — must key the instance at the `Over.mk` spelling:
50	`letI : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom) := d.grpObj` (pure defeq, zero cost; mathlib itself
51	uses the same ascription idiom in `Group/Smooth.lean`).  Instances stated directly on
52	`G : Over (Spec (.of K))` (e.g. `IsClosedImmersion η[G].left`) fire on `d.J` with no
53	massage at all.  The `example`-level smoke tests at the bottom of this file are the
54	machine-checked record; the T-chain (tangent lane) and S2 (`Smooth` via
55	`smooth_of_grpObj`) may rely on this freely.
56	
57	## Main declarations
58	
59	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData C` — the frozen datum structure.
60	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.grpObj` — the group-object structure on `d.J` via
61	  `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` (the discharge route of the frozen `instGrpObj`).
62	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.homEquiv` / `homEquiv_comp` — the universal property
63	  in consumer form: `(T ⟶ d.J) ≃ pic0Subgroup C T`, natural against `pic0Map`.
64	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.uniqueUpToIso` / `homEquiv_uniqueUpToIso_hom` — any
65	  two data have canonically isomorphic representing objects (Wave-7's `baseChangeIso`
66	  mechanism), with the intertwining property.
67	-/

70	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

73

75	
76	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
77	
78	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
79	
80	/-- **The pinned representability datum** for the degree-zero étale-sheafified relative
81	Picard functor of the curve `C` (w4-datum-worksheet §1.1, frozen).  Produced once, by
82	explicit construction, in Wave 4 (DAT-J: `jacobianData`); consumed as a section
83	variable everywhere else.  NEVER a sorried instance, NEVER `Nonempty` + choice.
84	
85	The typing of `rep` is chosen so that `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` applies verbatim with
86	`F := pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat` (see `JacobianData.grpObj`). -/
87	structure JacobianData (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
88	    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
89	    Type (u + 1) where
90	  /-- The representing object (the Jacobian-to-be). -/
91	  J : Over (Spec (.of k))
92	  /-- The pinned universal datum: `Hom(T, J) ≃ Pic⁰(T)`, naturally in the test `T`. -/
93	  rep : ((pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat).RepresentableBy J
94	  /-- Certificate from the construction (Kleiman 4.8(1) shape); NOT re-derived via the
95	  EGA limit criterion. -/
96	  locallyOfFiniteType : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom
97	  /-- Certificate from the construction (a posteriori: `|J|` is the image of a
98	  quasi-compact divisor scheme under the Abel map).  Feeds `IsProper` (Wave 5) via
99	  `finite type = qc + lft`. -/
100	  quasiCompact : QuasiCompact J.hom
101	
102	namespace JacobianData
103	
104	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
105	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
106	
107	/-- The group-object structure on the representing object, via mathlib's
108	`GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` — this is the (definitional) discharge route of the frozen
109	`Jacobian.instGrpObj`.  Not a global instance here (the datum is a section variable);
110	activate per proof with `letI := d.grpObj` or
111	`attribute [local instance] JacobianData.grpObj`. -/
112	@[implicit_reducible]

114	  GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy d.J (pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) d.rep
115	
116	/-- **The universal property, consumer form**: morphisms into `d.J` are degree-zero
117	étale Picard classes.  This accessor owns the `forget₂ ⋙ forget` defeq massage once:
118	the target is the honest subgroup carrier `pic0Subgroup C T`. -/
119	def homEquiv (d : JacobianData C) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} :
120	    (T ⟶ d.J) ≃ pic0Subgroup C T :=
121	  d.rep.homEquiv
122	
123	/-- Naturality of `homEquiv` against the degree-zero restriction maps `pic0Map`
124	(element form of the `RepresentableBy` naturality, with the functor value unfolded
125	through `forget₂ ⋙ forget`). -/
126	theorem homEquiv_comp (d : JacobianData C) {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
127	    (f : T' ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ d.J) :
128	    d.homEquiv (f ≫ g) = pic0Map C f (d.homEquiv g) :=
129	  d.rep.homEquiv_comp f g
130	
131	/-- Representing objects are unique up to isomorphism (mathlib
132	`Functor.RepresentableBy.uniqueUpToIso`): any two Jacobian data for the same curve have
133	canonically isomorphic `J`.  This is Wave-7's `baseChangeIso` mechanism. -/
134	noncomputable def uniqueUpToIso (d d' : JacobianData C) : d.J ≅ d'.J :=
135	  d.rep.uniqueUpToIso d'.rep
136	
137	/-- The intertwining property of `uniqueUpToIso`: composing with the canonical
138	isomorphism commutes with the two universal properties. -/
139	theorem homEquiv_uniqueUpToIso_hom (d d' : JacobianData C) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
140	    (f : T ⟶ d.J) :
141	    d'.homEquiv (f ≫ (d.uniqueUpToIso d').hom) = d.homEquiv f := by
142	  have h : (d.uniqueUpToIso d').hom = d'.rep.homEquiv.symm (d.rep.homEquiv (𝟙 d.J)) := rfl
143	  rw [homEquiv, homEquiv, h, Functor.RepresentableBy.comp_homEquiv_symm]
144	  exact (d'.rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).trans (d.rep.homEquiv_eq f).symm
145	
146	end JacobianData

148	/-! ## η-defeq smoke tests (recon §5 lower-order unknown; `example`-level, nothing
149	registered)
150	
151	The first test records that `Over.mk d.J.hom ≡ d.J` definitionally (structure eta); the

```

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]

variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
```

### (1) What `divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter` represents, and over what carrier

Signature (`Pic0RankOneLocus.lean:232`):
```
def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
```
It is **not itself a functor on schemes**: it is a `Subfunctor` of the representable presheaf `yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)` on the slice category `(Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ`.

- **Carrier object / scheme.** `divRepAffGenusScheme C : Over (Spec (.of k))` (`DivRepAffChallenge.lean:120`) is a chosen object of the slice over `Spec k` representing the widened divisor functor `divFunctorAff C (genus C)` at the curve's genus. Its representability is unconditional: `divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C : (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).RepresentableBy (divRepAffGenusScheme C)` (`DivRepAffChallenge.lean:125`). So the "carrier scheme" is `divRepAffGenusScheme C` (its underlying scheme is `(divRepAffGenusScheme C).left`).

- **What subfunctor it picks out.** It is the pullback, through the representation iso, of the subfunctor on the affine divisor functor whose Abel class lands in the rank-one Picard locus. The chain (`Pic0RankOneLocus.lean:226-235`):
```
def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
```
i.e. `divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi` = the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen pi` under the widened Abel transformation `abelDivAffTrans C (genus C) : divFunctorAff C (genus C) ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)`. Then `divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi` transports that along `(divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom` onto `yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)`.

- **Concrete membership** is pinned down in `DivRankOneOpen.lean` twice:
  - as an alias `divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi := divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi` (`DivRankOneOpen.lean:40`, and `divRankOneUniversalPredicate_eq_preimage : ... = ... := rfl` at line 324);
  - unfolded pointwise by `divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma` (`DivRankOneOpen.lean:96`): a represented divisor `x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T` lies in the predicate iff its `Σ`-extended Abel image `(abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left` lifts through the public rank-one locus inclusion `picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi`.

So: it represents "represented genus-degree divisors whose Abel class is rank-one", as a subfunctor of the Yoneda functor of the genus divisor representer `divRepAffGenusScheme C`.

---

### (2) Exact statement of `rankOneAbelRepresented` (the restricted Abel natural transformation)

Signature (`Pic0RankOneLocus.lean:251`):
```
def rankOneAbelRepresented :
    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi
```
It is a natural transformation from the functor underlying the represented rank-one divisor preimage into the functor underlying the public rank-one Picard locus. It factors as the composite of two restrictions:

```
def rankOneAbelAff :
    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))          -- Pic0RankOneLocus.lean:238

    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom                      -- Pic0RankOneLocus.lean:244
```
So `rankOneAbelRepresented` = (transport represented → affine via the representation iso) then (widened Abel map restricted to the rank-one preimage → `PicRankOneOpen`).

The immediate consumer lemma confirming its target (`Pic0RankOneLocus.lean:259`):
```
theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_mem {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
    ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x :
      (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
  ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x).property
```
i.e. the restricted represented Abel map always lands in the rank-one locus (this holds now; the stronger *inverse*/isomorphism does not — see (4)).

Supporting pieces used above:
- `abelDivAffGenusSigma C : yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶ Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))` (`Pic0EndgameContract.lean:84`) is the ambient genus Abel map on the big site, `abelDivAffSigma C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C)`. `DivRankOneOpen` is a scheme **only given a witness**; it never manufactures a default/top-open. The dependency chain is:

**The witness structure** (`DivRankOneOpen.lean:172`):
```
structure DivRankOneOpenData (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] where
  carrier : (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens
  carrier_eq :
    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) carrier =
      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi
```
where `openSubfunctor D U := Subfunctor.range (openSubfunctorMap D U)` (`DivRankOneOpen.lean:152`) and `openSubfunctorMap D U := yoneda.map (Over.homMk U.ι)` (`DivRankOneOpen.lean:144`). So the witness is: an actual open `U` of the genus representer whose Yoneda range **equals** the logical rank-one predicate. This is exactly the missing "identify the logical preimage with a real open" content.

**The scheme, conditional on the witness** (`DivRankOneOpen.lean:259`):
```
def DivRankOneOpen (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) : Scheme :=
  h.carrier.toScheme
```
with the canonical open immersion:
```
def divRankOneOpenMap (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
    DivRankOneOpen pi h ⟶ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left :=
  h.carrier.ι                                                             -- DivRankOneOpen.lean:263

theorem divRankOneOpen_isOpenImmersion (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
    IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenMap pi h)                              -- DivRankOneOpen.lean:267
```

    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}

    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔

```

```
theorem divRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem
    {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ} (f : T ⟶ T')
    {x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T}
    (hx : x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T) :

```

```
def divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) :
    DivRankOneOpenData pi := Classical.choice (divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen pi h)  -- line 254
```

Here `PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen` is itself only a **named acceptance gate**, not a theorem (`Pic0RankOneLocus.lean:127`):
```
def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
```

```

  →[gate, unproved] PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi
    →[divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen] Nonempty (DivRankOneOpenData pi)
      →[DivRankOneOpen] the open subscheme h.carrier.toScheme + all consumers

There is currently **no** unconditional inhabitant. To remove the `(h : DivRankOneOpenData pi)` / `(h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)` hypothesis one must produce either a `DivRankOneOpenData pi` outright or, upstream, a proof of `PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi`. ## Overview

The rank-one Picard machinery is stratified as a chain of contract structures over `k`-algebras, with the following global variable context shared by essentially every file:

```lean
variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
```

Everything lives in `namespace AlgebraicGeometry`. All structures are `Type (u+1)`. The four native constructors all funnel into the raw `PicRankOneNativePresentation.mk`.

---

## (1) `PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam`

Defined in `AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneNativePresentationOfLocal.lean` — actually the **structure** is defined in `.../Pic0RankOneNativePresentation.lean` (lines 54-76). Parameter `lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)`.

### Fields
```lean
structure PicRankOneNativePresentation
    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
  representative : descentClasses C cover
  represents :
    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
  datum_class :
    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
  native_pushforward_base_change :
    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app datum.nativeModule)
  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
  h0_rank_one :
    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
```

The distinguishing feature vs. `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` is that the module is **canonically** `datum.nativeModule` (not an auxiliary `module` field): the line-bundle certificate is derived from the datum's piece trivializations, so no unrelated line bundle can be substituted.

### Conversions / consumers (same file)
```lean
noncomputable def toLocalPresentation (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
    PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam
-- fills module := P.datum.nativeModule, module_iso := P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso,
--       line_bundle := P.datum.nativeModule_isLineBundle

theorem nonempty_localPresentation (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)

theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
        Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T
```

### Constructors

**`ofCertificates`** — `.../Pic0RankOneFamilyCertificates.lean` (lines 52-78). The most literal builder; takes the arbitrary-cartesian base change as an explicit `hpush` hypothesis.
```lean
noncomputable def ofCertificates
    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
    (x : descentClasses C E)
    (hrep : PicEtAff.mk C E x = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)
    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C E.Carrier pi)
    (hclass : (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) =
        relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) D.cechPicClass)
    (hpush :
      ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of E.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
        (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C E.Carrier)
        (sq : IsPullback g' f' (relCurve C E.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of E.Carrier)) g),
        IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app D.nativeModule))
    (cert : RankOneFamilyCertificates D) :
    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam
```

**`ofLocalPresentation`** — `.../Pic0RankOneNativePresentationOfLocal.lean` (lines 49-64). Canonicalizes an existing local presentation; derives `native_pushforward_base_change` from `D.isIso_canonicalBaseChangeMap_nativeModule` using `P.h1_vanishing`.
```lean
noncomputable def ofLocalPresentation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam
-- plus: theorem nonempty_of_localPresentation, theorem nonempty_of_localPresentations (pointwise, over Tᵒᵖ)
```

**`ofNativeDatum`** — `.../Pic0RankOneFamilyCertificatesActualDatum.lean` (lines 86-100). Builds from the actual lambda-tied datum + residue split witnesses via `ofCertificates`; still takes explicit `hpush`.
```lean
noncomputable def ofNativeDatum
    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    (hsplit : P.ResidueSplitWitnesses)
    (hpush :
      ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
        (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
        (sq : IsPullback g' f' (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g),
        IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.datum.nativeModule)) :
    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam
```

**`ofCertificatesWithNativeBaseChange`** — `.../Pic0RankOneNativeBaseChangeCartesian.lean` (lines 781-796). Like `ofCertificates` but the arbitrary-cartesian base-change field is **supplied automatically** by `D.isIso_canonicalBaseChangeMap_nativeModule` from `cert.h1_vanishing` (no `hpush` argument). This is the "complete" constructor.
```lean

    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
    (x : descentClasses C E)
    (hrep : PicEtAff.mk C E x = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)
    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C E.Carrier pi)
    (hclass : (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) =

```lean
structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
  representative : descentClasses C cover
  represents : PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi

  native_pushforward_base_change :
    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')

## (3) `exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation` — EXACT statement

```lean
theorem exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → P.cover.Carrier)
      (y : Fin m → Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
      (hy : ∀ (i : Fin m) (q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier),
        f i ∉ q.asIdeal →
          (y i ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
      (F0 : DivFamZarAff C P.cover.Carrier (genus C)),
      Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤ ∧
        (∀ i : Fin m,
          DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away (f i))) F0 =
            P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f i) (y i) (hy i)) ∧
        abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0 =
          PicEtAff.mapAlg C
            ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
            (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) ∧
        relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) F0.picClass =
          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin m,
          (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away (f i))) F0).picClass =
            (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away (f i))).cechPicClass) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin m,
          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
            ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
              (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
            (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 (y i)) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 (y i)
```

### Carrier and identities
- **Carrier of `F0`:** `F0 : DivFamZarAff C P.cover.Carrier (genus C)` — the glued divisor family lives over `P.cover.Carrier`, i.e. **the Noetherian carrier of the etale cover `EtaleCover A`, NOT over the original base `A`**. Degree is `genus C`. It is obtained by `DivFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_awaySpan` from the per-open local divisors `F i = P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f i) (y i) (hy i)` (each over `Localization.Away (f i)`), compatible on overlaps via `baseOpenRankOneDivisor_awayMul_compat`.
- **Identities carried (the conjunction):**
  1. `Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤` — the chosen principal opens span the unit ideal (finite Zariski cover of `Spec P.cover.Carrier`).
  2. **Localization/restriction law:** each away-restriction `DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (toAlgHom … (Localization.Away (f i))) F0` equals the local `P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f i) (y i) (hy i)`.
  3. **Abel value:** `abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0` equals the input class pushed to the cover: `PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k) (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)`.
  4. **Relative Picard class:** `relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) F0.picClass = (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))` — the glue's class is the presentation representative (proved via `PicEtAff.unit_injective`).
  5. **Per-open Cech-class identity:** each restricted `.picClass` equals `(P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away (f i))).cechPicClass`.
  6. **Native evaluation counit identity:** for each `i`, `P.evaluation` applied to `P.evaluationLiftOfH0 (y i)` equals `P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 (y i)`.

The docstring is explicit that this result is **Noetherian and presentation-carrier only**: it does NOT descend `F0` to `A`, does NOT prove presentation independence, does NOT construct an arbitrary-scheme pullback square, and does NOT produce `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.

Current state: `exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation` produces `F0 : DivFamZarAff C P.cover.Carrier (genus C)` — over the **etale cover carrier** `P.cover.Carrier` (an `Algebra.EtaleCover A`), Noetherian. import AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.AlgebraDescent
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Pullbacks

/-!
# Effective descent for affine schemes

This file applies `Spec` to the equalizer algebra constructed by
`Algebra.DescentDatum`.  It packages affine algebra effectivity as an
isomorphism in the category of schemes over the faithfully flat chart.

## Main declarations

* `Algebra.DescentDatum.baseScheme`: the spectrum of the descended algebra.
* `Algebra.DescentDatum.schemeBaseChangeIso`: its underlying scheme-level
  base-change isomorphism.
* `Algebra.DescentDatum.baseChangeIso`: the same isomorphism in the relevant
  over-category.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
open AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Algebra.DescentDatum

variable {A B R : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing R]
  [Algebra A B] [Algebra A R] [Algebra B R] [IsScalarTower A B R]

/-- The affine scheme over `Spec A` obtained from the equalizer algebra of a
commutative-algebra descent datum. -/
noncomputable def baseScheme (D : Algebra.DescentDatum A B R) :
    Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) :=
  Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A D.descended)))

/-- The original affine `B`-scheme encoded by a commutative-algebra descent
datum. -/
noncomputable def affineScheme (_D : Algebra.DescentDatum A B R) :
    Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of B)) :=
  Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B R)))

/-- The affine base map along which the descent datum is given. -/
noncomputable def coverMap (_D : Algebra.DescentDatum A B R) :
    Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A) :=

/-- The spectrum of the descended algebra becomes the original affine scheme

Div^g represented -> DivRankOneOpen -> rankOneAbelIso -> PicRankOneOpen
